card.name: Linking words in disclaimer and legal text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as and, or, nor, in, and only, in website disclaimers, copyright notices and restricted-program statements. The word comes right after a verb or noun and before a second parallel item or a condition.

modes.label: Disclaimer and copyright links
modes.description: And, or, nor or in joining parallel items in legal or disclaimer wording.
modes.example: Experts appearing on this page are independent and are solely responsible for editing<< and>> fact-checking their material.

modes.label: Available only through REMS
modes.description: The word only after 'is available' in restricted-program statements.
modes.example: EMPAVELI is available<< only>> through a restricted program under a REMS
